title: Natural tower currying isomorphism
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $a:X\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use ordinary module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, with completed coefficient sheaf $R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ for $W=X,s$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $F_n=Ra_{!,n}$ for compact support using one fixed compactification $a=pj$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], $G_n=Ra_n^!$ for the finite constructible comparison-class exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and $\omega_n=G_n(A_n)_s$. Fix a strict complex $Q_\bullet$ of $(A_n)_X$-modules with quotient-semilinear transitions, representing a normalized dualizing tower [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]: $Q_n$ represents $\omega_n$, and its transitions are adjoint to the counit-defined comparisons $\omega_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\cong\omega_n$ of [lem-coef-finite-dualizing]. Let $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_n)_X$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and suppose its reductions have Tor amplitude in one finite interval $[a_0,b_0]$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $C_n=\Gamma(s,F_nK_n)$ and $C=\Gamma(s,Ra_!K)$, with coefficient-point sections [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Suppose $\dim X\le d$ for an integer $d\ge0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\mathsf H(K),B_K,B_\omega$ and $\beta_K$ be the specified derived towers and dinatural pairing of [lem-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing]. Fix a trace $t:B_\omega\to A_\bullet$ evaluating to the finite counits, independently of $K$, using the compatible finite counits of [lem-coef-tower-trace-rectification] and the lift of [lem-weil-pbc-sequential-tower-evaluation-full]. Let $\eta_K:\operatorname{const}C\to B_K$ be the natural coaugmentation of [lem-coef-tower-coaugmentation]. Define $\mathsf J(C)$ to be the derived tower Hom from $\operatorname{const}C$ to $A_\bullet$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]; it is computed by termwise Hom from a constant K-flat representative of $C$ into a K-injective resolution of the whole tower $A_\bullet$. Thus $\operatorname{ev}_n\mathsf J(C)=\mathbf R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,A_n)$.
Currying the composite
$$\mathsf H(K)\otimes_R^L\operatorname{const}C\xrightarrow{1\otimes\eta_K}\mathsf H(K)\otimes_R^LB_K\xrightarrow{\beta_K}B_\omega\xrightarrow{t}A_\bullet$$
gives an isomorphism $\Gamma_K:\mathsf H(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf J(C)$ in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R)))$. Its evaluation at $n$ is $\gamma_{n,K_n}$ of [lem-coef-finite-mapping-adjunction] followed by the canonical scalar-adjunction isomorphism $\mathbf R\operatorname{Hom}_{A_n}(C_n,A_n)\cong\mathbf R\operatorname{Hom}_R(C,A_n)$. For every $f:K\to K'$ with induced $C(f):C\to C'$, the equality $\mathsf J(C(f))\circ\Gamma_{K'}=\Gamma_K\circ\mathsf H(f)$ holds in the derived tower category.
